title: Project lifecycle E2E (Profile, CapabilityProfile, Overview)

implementation_commits.summary: M-015 initial implementation: migration 0007, services, tests, exports
Fix capability ledger and contract trace entries
Update M-014 contract test to allow M-015 advancements
Fix review defects: SHA256SUMS, ledger parity, durable version, FOR UPDATE CAS, profile partial-update semantics, concurrent race tests

authority_model: Account -> Organization membership -> Project -> Artifact/ArtifactRelation. ProjectProfile and ProjectCapabilityProfile are subordinate Project-domain state, not new canonical authority roots. ProjectOverview is a read model/projection, not a canonical resource.

project_profiles.columns: project_id (PK/FK), description (nullable), cover_artifact_id (nullable), version (non-negative int), created_at, updated_at
constraints: cover FK: (project_id, cover_artifact_id) references artifacts(project_id, id) - same-Project enforcement

project_profile_implementation_subset: optional cover Artifact reference (same-Project enforced via composite FK)

project_capability_profile_semantics.optimistic_concurrency: expectedVersion-based, version starts at 0 for deterministic empty state
project_capability_profile_semantics.replacement: Atomic delete-all + insert in one transaction, deduplication, deterministic sort ordering

project_overview_contents: Project identity / Organization ownership / name / timestamps

creation_mode_parity.empty_project: Server-generated id, canonical Organization ownership, default profile (version 0), default capability profile (version 0)
creation_mode_parity.archive_import_project: Same canonical guarantees; import provenance accessible via overview
creation_mode_parity.clone_template_project: Same canonical guarantees; clone provenance accessible via overview, new ids and remapped graph

testing.skipped_live_policy: scripts/run-m015-lifecycle-integration.py hard-fails when DATABASE_URL is absent under CI=true. Outside CI it reports the skip loudly and returns 0.

known_limitations: Project Profile does not include sharing settings (deferred to M-117+).
ProjectCapabilityProfile is provider-neutral; no provider capability discovery is implemented.
ProjectOverview does not include future resources (AgentBinding, ModelBinding, etc.).
No durable event is emitted for profile or capability changes (M-026 owns event infrastructure).
PostgreSQL 18.4 live test results require CI with DATABASE_URL.
handoff: M-015 -> REVIEW. M-016 and later remain LOCKED. The pull request is not merged and not self-approved.
